title: Cosmic Customer Service.
old_caption: First time dating since the breakup and worried you're not ready? You don't have to wait until you're perfectly healed. Start small, and be honest about where you are.

title: Is it, though?
old_caption: Got the ick because he clapped when the plane landed? Turns out we all have small cringe habits. Give it a minute, and look for kindness before the little quirks.

title: The Intervention
old_caption:
Same person, four haircuts. When your friends gather to talk about your "type," it comes from love.
If it keeps hurting, it may be a pattern. Your new type can simply be someone who's good to you.

title: Meet the jealousy monster
old_caption: Their phone buzzes and a little green feeling grows on your shoulder. Scrolling makes it bigger. Saying "I felt jealous" out loud usually makes it smaller. Feelings shrink when they're spoken.

title: Overthinkzilla.
old_caption: "See ya" instead of "see you" and suddenly a what-if monster is stomping through a lovely evening. Overthinking grows the more you feed it. A simple question shrinks it fast.

title: Light-Years.
old_caption:
Four light-years apart, every goodnight takes years to land. Long distance can feel just as slow sometimes.
You can't fix the distance, but you can show up with effort. Same time, every night.

title: Live from Your 5th House
old_caption: "So, what do you do?" can stall a first date fast. Skip the résumé and ask something fun, like a hill they'd defend. Shared silliness is where the spark tends to show up.

title: Love, Translated.
old_caption: One partner bakes a pie, the other paints a banner, and both feel unloved. Love gets lost in translation. Ask how they like to be loved, then say it their way.

title: The Love Language Olympics
old_caption:
Leo shows love with a parade of gifts. Virgo quietly organizes the closet. Both are trying, in different languages.
Watch what lights your person up, then do more of that. Both of you deserve gold.

title: The Great Starzini.
old_caption: Dodging a hard question doesn't make it disappear. It usually comes back bigger. If they ask where this is going, an honest answer is the only trick you need.
